name: aws-sc-landing-zone
description: AWS European Sovereign Cloud (EUSC) Landing Zone IaC (AWS CDK v2, TypeScript). Current increment: AWS Organizations OUs, SCP/RCP policy code, and IAM Identity Center Permission Set baseline.
